claim_boundary.claim: A widefield-specific, input-only validity profile can control silent-invalid dimensionless structural measurements on independently held-out fields of view.
excluded_claims: physical-scale measurement because pixel spacing is not supplied

input_only_score.deployment_precondition: The acquisition profile declares the number of independent captures contributing to the analyzed image.
input_only_score.formula: capture_weight * max(0, sqrt(target_averaged_captures / averaged_captures) - 1) + perturbation_weight * perturbation_stability

operating_point.selection_rule: Highest cross-fitted coverage satisfying every predeclared development gate.
